case: AI-UC-2500 autonomous underwriting-status update above 98 percent confidence

learner_decisions.change_classification: Treat as a consequential system-authority expansion, not a model-threshold tuning change.
learner_decisions.registry_updates: Create a new agent revision and authoritative tool relation; update intended use, autonomy, affected stakeholders, and lifecycle to REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.
learner_decisions.risk_and_policy_floors: Apply the authoritative-mutation policy floor and preserve the consequential path regardless of aggregate score.
learner_decisions.human_authority: Require governance, underwriting, security, and privacy decisions within their scopes; the implementation agent has no approval role.
learner_decisions.evidence_obligations: Evaluate calibration and errors on representative slices, authorization, replay, ambiguous inputs, review bypass, privacy, injection, idempotency, rollback, and actual forbidden outcomes.
learner_decisions.reassessment_and_activation: Invalidate proposal-only approval and dependent evidence; prefer shadow/proposal comparison before any separately approved bounded activation.
learner_decisions.runtime_containment: Monitor authoritative mutations, review bypass, population coverage, tenant isolation, and model/tool identity; disable the mutation capability on protected-invariant failure.

recommended_decision: Do not activate the authority expansion on confidence alone; retain proposal-only operation until the new exact subject clears accountable reassessment and authorization.
simpler_alternative: Keep AI proposals and accelerate the authorized human review workflow.
